agent.summary: Added PF_XATTRS and PF_XATTR_STREAM to xs-rs: xattr configuration negotiation, per-entry and per-file xattr lists, streamed large values with XXH3-64 verification, xattr filtering, and receiver-side set/remove. C++ clients and servers exchange user and rsync-internal attributes in both directions, including a second -XX pass.
agent.diagnosis: Most work went into matching src/xattrs.cpp namespace rules (user.*, user.rsync.% internal names, -X versus -XX) and the remote.cpp framing: XATTR_CONFIG after compression, XATTR_START/CHUNK/END before the DIR/DATA that references them, and xattr fields after filter_source and after HLINK. Tests pin the exact list bytes and verify a 65 KiB streamed value round-trips with the C++ digest.
agent.change: New rs/xs-rs/src/xattr.rs implements xattr reading/writing via llistxattr/lgetxattr/lsetxattr/lremovexattr, protocol list encoding/decoding, stream sender/receiver, namespace mapping and filters. Wired -X/--xattrs/--no-xattrs and -XX into CLI, HELLO feature advertisement and validation, XATTR_CONFIG handling, DIR entry and DATA attribute encoding/decoding, and receiver application for files, directories, links and special files. Added xattr filter predicates to FilterList.
agent.expected_effect: xs-rs now interoperates with xs-c++ for extended attributes, including empty, binary and up-to-64 KiB values, internal namespaces on -XX, stale-attribute removal, and xattr filters. The framing matches C++ byte for byte; large values use the C++ stream format and digest.
agent.risks: Linux-only as the case requires. Setting user.* attributes on symlinks can fail with EPERM, as on the reference platform. Itemized-change output does not yet mark xattr-only updates with 'x'. Push filters without --delete follow C++'s asymmetry where xattr-only rules are not sent to the receiver. Values above 64 KiB are covered by unit tests rather than filesystem integration because Linux filesystems cap one xattr near 64 KiB.
